transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Lee. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Lee. Well, I'm here because... I guess I've been having a real problem with eating lately. After I finish my shifts as a cashier, I just keep buying these huge takeout orders. Like, I'm talking about enough food for a whole family—burgers, fries, a bunch of chicken, desserts. And I'll just sit there and eat almost all of it by myself before I even go home.
After you eat like this, do you ever try to get rid of the food or make up for it—like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot?
No, I don't do anything like that. I don't throw up or take anything... and I definitely don't exercise. I just go home and feel terrible about it.
How often would you say these binge-eating episodes happen, and for how many months has this been going on?

Well, for the last several months, it's been happening pretty often... probably three or four nights most weeks. Honestly, I can't remember a single week since the foreclosure calls started where I didn't do it at least once.
